title: GTA6 Worldwide Unlock Times Revealed: Xbox NZ Trick May Still Work
description: Grand Theft Auto 6 worldwide unlock times revealed, with the game arriving November 19 on PS5 and Xbox Series X/S. Xbox owners may still use the New Zealand trick.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## GTA6 Worldwide Unlock Times and the Classic Xbox Trick

As the release date for Rockstar Games' highly anticipated blockbuster approaches, the details surrounding how players across the globe will actually get their hands on the game are starting to emerge. According to a report by gaming media outlet Eurogamer, **Grand Theft Auto 6** is scheduled to arrive on **19th November** for **PlayStation 5** and **Xbox Series X/S**. However, depending on your geographic location around the world, the exact moment you get to actually play will vary.

### Understanding the Global Rollout

For console owners, simultaneous or staggered regional rollouts are a standard part of major game launches. Eurogamer notes that while the launch date is locked in for November 19th, the precise timing of when servers or digital licenses unlock will depend heavily on where players are located globally. 

Interestingly, the report highlights a familiar strategy for a specific platform community. Xbox owners can seemingly still utilize the old "New Zealand trick" to play early. This long-standing community method of taking advantage of time zone differences has been a staple for eager fans looking to bypass local midnight launches by shifting their system or account regions.

### Preparing for Launch Day

As anticipation reaches an all-time high for GTA6 on PS5 and Xbox Series X/S, players are advised to keep a close eye on official channels for final, region-specific breakdown schedules. Ensuring your console has the game pre-loaded ahead of time will be crucial for diving straight into the experience the moment the clock strikes.

## Editor's Take

The discussion surrounding GTA6's unlock times and the enduring appeal of the New Zealand trick highlights just how eager the community is to step into Rockstar's next masterpiece. Whether playing early via time zone shifts proves fully viable or not, November 19th is shaping up to be a monumental day for console owners worldwide. Stay prepared and get ready for launch.
